design.process_tree: parent spawns two middle processes concurrently; each middle spawns two Go workers concurrently
design.cpu_accounting: cooperative per-parent ProcessState UserTime + SystemTime, aggregate descendant receipts
design.rss: sum of individual peak RSS is conservative upper bound, NOT simultaneous tree peak; max individual physical high water separately
design.safety: source-only isolated deterministic validation, no original-world experiments or training

caveats: Not Windows Job Object based accounting
Not OS-complete process tree if uncooperative children are orphaned or short-lived
Sum individual peak RSS is not concurrent tree peak
Worker timing/output digest may vary because time-based loop; test never claims deterministic cross-host checksum
Needs actual hosted CI execution and original artifacts before PASS

next_gate.action: Fetch real G32 hosted Linux and Windows source-head jobs, identify and fix failures with bounded source-only changes, inspect archived receipts and preserve pass/fail. Then implement kernel complete tree measurement separately if necessary.
